integrity: Complete analytic proof plus standalone finite cross-checks; source comparisons and self-review only, with no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs with uniform proper q-colourings, q>=3, and uniform numbers of independent pendant leaves. Sharp condition-number claims require positive definite core one-frequency Gram matrix. No claims for higher character degrees, q=2, or arbitrary Gibbs weights. An equivalent broader historical Potts-covariance theorem might exist.
title: Universal Fourier spectral transfer under pendant-colour amplification
